summary: Compared the product-related reference, rendered and diff crops against the frozen related-product source records and passing wrapper geometry. The source heading and two native product identities are known, but the visible section composition does not match (12.583% crop mismatch).

PB-RELATED-002 | priority: critical | property: related product cards | expected: two visible bordered cards with source-backed Stomp Aqua 455 CS 1L and 5L media/content | actual: no related-product cards are visible in the retained section crop | fix: render the two native related products in the source card grid with their exact sourced images, titles and prices.

PB-RELATED-003 | priority: medium | property: heading typography | expected: large bold heading matching the reference | actual: substantially smaller regular-weight heading | fix: match the source heading size, weight and line height.
